quality_boundary: The completed scope covers official survey methodology, 34 summary evaluation items, and 26 future-priority multiple-response items. Survey-derived perceptions and citizen-stated priorities remain separate from administrative performance, policy achievement, budget execution, settlement outcomes, causal attribution, and Jichi Insight ranking.
